source: Contribution limits as carried by the existing FOO room; re-verify against IRS Notice for the plan year before relying on them.
note: IRS-defined and changes annually. Year-tagged per SPEC.md Section 7. Never inline these in a calculator. annualAdditions is the overall cap on employee deferral plus employer contribution to one plan. soloEmployerShareSoleProprietor is 20%, NOT 25%: the 25% figure applies to a corporation's W2 wages, whereas a sole proprietor's base is net earnings AFTER the employer contribution itself, and 25/(1+25) resolves to 20%. Getting that wrong is the classic Solo 401k error.
